note: Canonical fixtures for spec 008 (passkey authentication). Synthetic data only. User descriptors consumed by test helpers — one definition only (this file). Ceremony fixtures are produced at test time by tests/Helpers/VirtualAuthenticator.php (deterministic EC P-256 keypair, attestation format 'none', UV flag set) against the pinned test RP ID (phpunit.xml: WEBAUTHN_ID=localhost, WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS=http://localhost) — no recorded real-device transcripts, no real credentials.

users.description: org_admin with no factor at all — the setup-mode case, passkey path
users.expects: login issues restricted setup-mode session; enrollment page offers BOTH passkey and TOTP (C-01); registering a passkey clears setup mode (C-03) and issues 8 recovery codes shown once (008-D02)

users.description: org_admin with a confirmed passkey only (label 'iPhone')
users.expects: password step redirects to the challenge (passkey-only users ARE challenged); valid assertion completes login with no setup flag (C-04); a recovery code also completes login via the existing challenge POST (008-D02)

users.description: org_admin with confirmed TOTP only (the 005 baseline user)
users.expects: everything behaves exactly as spec 005 — challenge accepts TOTP; the 005 suite passes unmodified (C-09)

users.description: attorney with confirmed TOTP and one passkey (label 'YubiKey — office')
users.expects: challenge page offers both proofs; either a valid TOTP code or a valid assertion completes login (C-09)

users.description: attorney with a passkey only — voluntary enrollment, no MFA requirement
users.expects: login is challenged (an enrolled factor is always used); no setup-mode flag at any point (the requirement is admin-only, as in 005 C-06)

users.description: adversarial: second user in the same org whose passkey assertion is replayed against U-PK-02's challenged session
users.expects: assertion names a credential not owned by the challenged user → generic failure, audited, no login (C-05)

users.description: adversarial: assertion transcripts with a wrong-origin clientDataJSON and with a replayed (already-consumed) challenge
org_admin whose only factor is one passkey; the passkey is revoked (password confirmation given)
users.expects: credential row gone, mfa.passkey.revoked audited; current session untouched; NEXT login lands in setup mode (C-06)
